turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
You can usually find your tracking link in the SHIPPING CONFIRMATION EMAIL sent once your order has shipped. That email includes your tracking information, so it’s worth checking your SPAM/JUNK FOLDER too.
If you didn’t receive that email, the brand recommends logging into your Naked Wardrobe account and checking your ORDER HISTORY to be directed to your tracking information.
Tracking updates can also take 24–48 HOURS to appear after the shipping confirmation is sent.
